description: Calculates the future value of an investment using compound interest formula: FV = PV × (1 + r)^n, where r is annual interest rate and n is years. (cost: 1 credit)

annual_interest_rate.description: number, required, annual interest rate as a percentage (e.g., 5 for 5%)

present_value.description: number, required, current value or principal amount in currency units

years.description: number, required, number of years for the investment

name: future_investment_value
